body:
Put common expression/statement mechanisms in core layers and engine syntax in pg/mysql/sqlite/ch. Use dialect capabilities and engine guards, then test wrong-dialect refusal as well as the intended SQL. This catches a query built for the wrong engine before it reaches the server; it does not detect server-version or extension availability.

Evidence: ds:block?id=dialect-contract-smkbmeyz; ds:block?id=dialect-failure-zqdgvzs3; ds:block?id=postgres-arrays-5w7ytu86; ds:block?id=postgres-extensions-j5kc5mqu. See docs/architecture.md and docs/operating-notes.md. Verified from the implementation and tests on 2026-11-01; server-test gates are explicitly distinguished from execution.
title: Keep portable mechanisms and guarded engine syntax separate
